stem.text: Halogenoalkanes can undergo reaction with hydroxide ions.
The reaction of some halogenoalkanes proceeds by the $\text{S}_\text{N}1$ mechanism.
Which statements about the $\text{S}_\text{N}1$ mechanism are correct?

items: A carbocation is formed which is stabilised by the inductive effect of the alkyl groups present.
Only tertiary halogenoalkanes are hydrolysed in this way.
The intermediate formed includes a carbon atom with five bonds attached to it.
